reviews.title: Hidden auto-renewal, no receipts, unrecognizable billing name
reviews.text: A $15.65 purchase unexpectedly turned into $40.12/month for a year. No receipts, no renewal notices, and the charges showed up under a name I couldn't recognize ("HELP.MSHERIDAN WY"). When I found them, I got replies from five different agents in six days. Support refunded one month and refused the rest, citing terms dated eleven months after my purchase. Check your card statement if you've ever bought from them.

reviews.title: Books are better
reviews.text:
Last year I got really into reading about fitness and put together some workout plans that have been working well for me. I decided to try Muscle Charge for the calisthenics aspect of it and out of curiosity about what I might be missing

I would not recommend this app.

There is nothing in the way of instruction for which muscles should be activated during the exercises or tips on how to achieve proper form for safety.  In the past when Ive tried workout videos Ive gotten tendon issues and sciatic pain - this brought all that back within a few workouts.

For context, I walk at least 10 miles a week, do weighted carry exercises up steep hills, and can paddle 14 miles - Im not out of shape. But these videos were boring, impractical, not educational and didn’t really feel all that safe for me personally. 

I would highly suggest Delavier’s fitness books - great illustrations and explanations about the benefits and dangers of each exercise with multiple variations and ‘Built From Broken’ by Scott Hogan can help you understand how you injured yourself in the past and prevent doing that moving forward so you can be fit into the future.

reviews.text: Paid money per month subscription. Downloaded the app message sent to my Gmail. My Gmail did not want to open it because it said it was not a trusted site. Then I went to my phone to see what happened and it said it wanted to permission to view my clipboard to verify I don’t feel comfortable with this at all. I’ve never had to do anything like this before with an app I purchased so I think I’m just gonna say I lost $15. Certainly not worth risking more.
